Job Title: Account Executive
Experience: 1+ years
Location: Hybrid: Bengaluru or Pune, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- B2B Sales
- Salesforce or Lead Generation
Good to have:
- HubSpot
- Key Account Management
- CRM

Responsibilities:
- Manage the full sales cycle for mid-market and enterprise prospects, from lead qualification through contract negotiation and closing.
- Work closely with marketing and SDR teams to convert inbound and outbound leads into opportunities using Salesforce or other lead generation tools.
- Develop and maintain a strong pipeline, track activity and forecast accurately in Salesforce, and report weekly sales metrics.
- Build relationships with key stakeholders at target accounts to understand business needs and position our solutions effectively.
- Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure smooth handover and successful implementation for closed accounts.
- Participate in account planning and support upsell and cross-sell initiatives for existing customers.
- Maintain organized records of customer interactions and sales activity in CRM systems; suggest process improvements to increase efficiency.
- Attend regional customer meetings, industry events, and internal sales training as required.
